204.description: Reset email sent if account exists

400.description: Token invalid or expired, or password too short

CanonicalColumn.description: A canonical column the system understands. Extend as needed.

ColumnMapping.description: A user's markup of an uploaded file.

ColumnTarget.description:
A reference to a logical column.

`canonical` matches the canonical schema (sku, name, brand, price, qty…).
`output_name` lets a global transform target an extra (output-only) column.

oneOf.description: Multiply numeric value by a constant.

ColumnTransform.description: Transforms applied per-column while reading a source file.

oneOf.description: Multiply a numeric column by a factor.
Increase a numeric column by percent.
Drop rows where the predicate is true.
Keep only rows where the predicate is true.
Set a column to a constant.
Round numeric column to N decimals.
Deduplicate rows by a column's value (keeps first occurrence).

GlobalTransform.description: Transforms applied to the merged dataset as a whole.

MappedColumn.description: One column inside a `ColumnMapping.columns` JSON array.

canonical.description:
Canonical name; if None, the column is read but not used in the output
unless an `extra` output column references it by header.

source_header.description: Header text as seen in the file (informational).

OutputColumn.description: One column in a user-defined output format.

canonical.description:
If set, this column is sourced from the canonical schema.
If None and `extra` is true, the column is synthesized from
`default_value` (and may be filled in by global transforms).

name.description: Header text written in the output file.
